questions.q: Scenario: a supply planner needs to decide how many drivers to incentivise for next Friday evening. Why are intervals more useful than a point forecast?
options: They show the risk, so the planner can choose a safe level for the cost of being short or long
why: Correct: decisions depend on risk and costs.
